item.title: By: Erwin Colón
item.dc:creator: Erwin Colón
item.description:
I recently wrote to a good friend about a viewing I attended for my Godmother. Over the years there have been family feuds and distancing among siblings and their extended families. After the eulogy, friends and family were asked to speak. A lot of tears, regrets, looking back and 'what ifs'.
Then a frail, soft-spoken black preacher came to the podium with Gospel in hand and pierced the alpha and omega-minded mourners with one simple statement. "Heaven is only a breath away. Are you ready?"
item.content:encoded:
I recently wrote to a good friend about a viewing I attended for my Godmother. Over the years there have been family feuds and distancing among siblings and their extended families. After the eulogy, friends and family were asked to speak. A lot of tears, regrets, looking back and ‘what ifs’.

Then a frail, soft-spoken black preacher came to the podium with Gospel in hand and pierced the alpha and omega-minded mourners with one simple statement. “Heaven is only a breath away. Are you ready?”
